title: 第5章 让我摸摸你的腹肌第6章 瞌睡来了送枕头
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
沧溟的眼睛死死的盯着朝自己走过来的白婉婉，手上的武器被他的掌心摩挲了好几下。
他知道自己被抽走的魔力之后其实跟普通人差不多，想要伤到面前这个修真者简直就是天方夜谭。
但是沧溟不想再过这样每天被压榨的日子了，就算是被杀了也比在这里受折磨的好。
白婉婉离沧溟愈来愈近，就在他准备动手的瞬间，一直没说话的江欲却开口了。
“住手。”
原主说话的时候每次都是小心翼翼的，就连声音都不敢大声。
江欲这下说出来的这两个字却丝毫没有懦弱的感觉，带着几分凌厉，让白婉婉和沧溟都愣了一下，转头看向了江欲的方向。
被盯着的江欲没有看白婉婉，而是转头看向了沧溟的方向，脸上带着几分不怀好意的笑。
沧溟不知道江欲要做什么，但是看到这个笑容就觉得准没好事，手上的长刀默默地转向了江欲的方向。
“不要这么激动。”
江欲的手看起来像是随意的搭在了沧溟的刀上，但却让沧溟心里一紧，他觉得江欲好像发现了自己的打算。
可是这怎么可能呢，江欲之前只是一个不学无术的草包，怎么可能会有这么敏锐的感知力。
“我跟你打个赌。”江欲丝毫没管面前的人因为警惕已经开始微微发抖的手，笑着开口道：“你敢不敢。”
她说话的声音有些小，只有身边站得最近沧溟能够听到。
沧溟皱眉，想要抽回自己的长刀，却被江欲死死地捏住根本抽不动，只好压低声音咬牙切齿的开口：“你又想干什么？”
“我跟你说你要是不想拿回玉净瓶就不要在这里假惺惺，你就是想要把我的角……”
“我要是输了，赌注你自己说。”
江欲一句话就把原本还在放狠话的沧溟定住了，他几乎是瞬间就抬头看向了面前的人，似乎是在确认自己是不是听错了。
被盯着的江欲丝毫没有躲闪，满是肉的脸上居然让沧溟看出了几分自信。
明明这个女人自从胖了之后就不敢抬头见人，甚至每天出门都会带上面纱挡住自己。

这时候沧溟才注意到今天的江欲出门居然没有带面纱，还抬头大大方方的将自己之前最自卑的脸露了出来。
奇怪，太奇怪了。
现在居然还要和自己打什么赌。
沧溟想要拒绝让江欲不要耍花招，可是脑子里浮现出了她那句赌注任由她提的话。
他知道自己不应该相信这个女人的，但是万一她说的是真的，他好像可以用这个赌注换得自己的自由身。
沧溟沉默了瞬间，下定决心般开口道：“可以。”
“要是我赌赢了，你放我自由。”
沧溟说出自己要求的时候根本没有想过江欲会同意，毕竟他可是现在江欲最得力的奴隶，她怎么可能会这么轻易的放过自己。
但是让他没想到的是，江欲听到这个要求丝毫没有惊讶的表情，只是挑了挑眉就开口同意了他的要求。
“可以啊。”
这下不只是沧溟震惊了，就连江欲脑子里的系统也有些不敢相信。
【宿主你真的要放走这个人吗？】
content_en:
Cangming's eyes were fixed on Bai Wanwan who was walking towards him, and the weapon in his hand was rubbed several times by his palm.
He knew that after his magic power was taken away, he was almost like an ordinary person. It was simply impossible to hurt the cultivator in front of him.
But Cangming no longer wants to live a life of being squeezed every day. Even if he is killed, it is better than being tortured here.
Bai Wanwan was getting closer and closer to Cangming. Just when he was about to take action, Jiang Yu, who had been silent, spoke up.
"Stop."
The original owner was cautious every time he spoke, not even daring to speak loudly.
The two words Jiang Yu said now did not sound cowardly at all, but were a bit fierce. Bai Wanwan and Cang Ming were stunned for a moment and turned to look in Jiang Yu's direction.
Jiang Yu, who was being stared at, did not look at Bai Wanwan, but turned to look in the direction of Cangming, with a somewhat malicious smile on his face.
Cangming didn't know what Jiang Yu was going to do, but when he saw this smile, he felt that something was up to him. The long knife in his hand turned silently in Jiang Yu's direction.
"Don't be so excited."
Jiang Yu's hand seemed to be resting on Cang Ming's knife casually, but it made Cang Ming's heart tighten. He felt that Jiang Yu seemed to have discovered his plan.
But how is this possible? Jiang Yu was just an ignorant idiot before, how could he have such a keen perception.
"I'll make a bet with you." Jiang Yu didn't care at all that the hands of the person in front of him were shaking slightly due to vigilance, and said with a smile: "Do you dare?"
Her voice was a little soft, and only Cangming, who was standing closest to her, could hear her.
Cangming frowned and wanted to withdraw his long knife, but Jiang Yu held it tightly and couldn't pull it away. He had to lower his voice and gritted his teeth and said: "What do you want to do again?"
"I'm telling you, if you don't want to get the jade bottle back, don't pretend here. You just want to take my corner..."
"If I lose, you decide on your own bet."
Jiang Yu's words stopped Cangming, who was still speaking harshly, and he looked up at the person in front of him almost instantly, as if to confirm whether he heard correctly.
Jiang Yu, who was being stared at, did not dodge at all, and Cangming could see a bit of confidence in his fleshy face.
It is obvious that this woman has not dared to raise her head to see people since she gained weight, and even puts on a veil to block herself every day when she goes out.
At this time, Cangming noticed that Jiang Yu didn't wear a veil when he went out today. He raised his head and openly showed his most inferior face.
Strange, so strange.
Now he actually wants to make a bet with himself.
Cangming wanted to refuse and tell Jiang Yu not to play tricks, but her words about letting her make bets came to mind.
He knew that he shouldn't believe this woman, but if what she said was true, it seemed that he could exchange this bet for his freedom.
Cangming was silent for a moment, then said with determination: "Okay."
"If I win the bet, you let me go free."
When Cangming made her request, she never thought that Jiang Yu would agree. After all, he was Jiang Yu's most powerful slave now. How could she let her go so easily.
But what he didn't expect was that Jiang Yu didn't show any surprise when he heard this request. He just raised his eyebrows and agreed to his request.
"Okay."
Not only was Cangming shocked now, but even the system in Jiang Yu's mind couldn't believe it.
[Host, do you really want to let this person go? 】
